verdict.rationale: A domain registrar with a public API could plausibly publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The pack shows only API endpoint responses, RDAP output, Go SDK and Terraform provider READMEs, and knowledgebase articles. Nothing in it mentions an llms.txt file or documentation written for AI agents, and conventional developer READMEs do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
